item.title: Native Works Rattler 230
item.excerpt:
This is a new release lure and is much easier to use after making great refinement to the previous Rattle 3.
The body is slimmer and its unique 8 shape slalom action is maintain.
Great casting distance.
Coating is much more lasting.
By changing the weight balance and shape, miss action is reduced and lessen the burden of push back lure.

Triangle structure of specially development.
It is effective also for a low active fish.

100% handmade in Japan by Mr Kawauchi Kenichi, his lures are exceptional and undoubtly unique.

  • Length 230 mm

  • Gr. 120

nextItem.title: Native Works Tank Popper 190
nextItem.excerpt:
This product is made for GT. It was developed with the aim of reducing fatigue from casting to action and allowing the angler to continue throwing.We designed it to have the lowest possible center of gravity, and made it so that it would resonate more bass than splashing.The shape reduces action errors as much as possible, so it can be used in any sea conditions. It has a particularly good track record in deep water. As a result of prioritizing flying distance and action by using special wood, we have judged that the goodness of the product will be lost if more strength is demanded.

Recommended Hook BKK-Z Raptor 5/0 or equivelant.

  • Length 190 mm

  • Gr. 120
